documented_gaps.OWNED_LOCAL_PROVIDER_BOT_OWNER_EDGE_DRIF: Live owned-runtime replay on the current dev binary (first attempted 2026-10-30 against apps/bcs/target/debug/bcs, binary sha256 dcbc39f07cedb62c8764987caa9fb05983dd7b3b1e6185022281cf0daa73d8d3) blocks at story request 8: PUT /bots/{bot_uuid}/visibility answered 403 "owner or manager role required for bot bot_..." and GET /bots/{bot_uuid} answered 403 "Not authorized to access bot". Provider Bot registration records created_by but never seeds bcs-edge-permission owner/manager edges, and POST /me/ensure-human backfills only list_legacy_bots_for_owner (legacy registration path), so the minting Human never gains an authority role over provider-registered Bots. The upstream story was frozen at f181ba44 (2026-10-22, provider-scoped owner collaboration #2654) and predates the bot-authority model c6f001209 (2026-10-27, #2625) that made these surfaces require authority edges. The frozen map stays unmodified; the drift is recorded here and the slice stays LOCAL_EXECUTOR_ONLY BLOCKED until a reviewed product decision re-scopes either the seeding contract or the story.
documented_gaps.PREPROD_PROVIDER_ADMIN_FACE_ABSENT: The preprod faces expose group.* and session.* routes only (profiles/preprod.example.json route_bindings and the live preprod profile); the Provider registration/admin surface (/providers, /providers/{provider_id}/bots) is a BCS-internal face authenticated by the provider_admin_token bearer and admitted through loopback X-Mock-User-Id headers, neither of which exists on the preprod gateway, and no provider_admin_token credential channel is declared in any preprod profile auth.header_env. Remote preprod execution of this slice is unsupported by design, not by missing effort.
documented_gaps.WORKBENCH_WS_MOCK_ADMISSION: The Workbench WebSocket 101 upgrade and the owner/foreign connect projection boundary depend on loopback X-Mock-User-Id admission available only on the owned-local runtime; no preprod Workbench WebSocket evidence is claimed by this slice.

adaptability.blocker: The Provider registration/admin face is absent from the preprod public-v1 route bindings and no provider_admin_token credential channel exists there (PREPROD_PROVIDER_ADMIN_FACE_ABSENT), and the owned-local live replay currently blocks because provider-registered Bots receive no authority owner edges (OWNED_LOCAL_PROVIDER_BOT_OWNER_EDGE_DRIFT). Neither environment grants release credit.
